title: Lottie
summary: Small accents in the editorial style, generated from code in lottie/generate.mjs: ink strokes with butt ends and mitred corners on paper, one wine accent per mark, hairlines beside heavy rules. Rules draw, shapes glide in on a quart-out curve and settle; nothing bounces, flashes or glows.

items.name: Rule draw
items.description: A heavy ink rule draws from the left with a hairline under it a moment later and a small wine square above its start: a section opening.

items.name: Underline swipe
items.description: A wine underline draws from the left over a hairline, holds, and leaves to the right the way it came.

items.name: Arrow
items.description: An ink arrow: the shaft draws, the head opens from its point, and the arrow glides a little forward over a short wine rule.

items.name: Bracket pair
items.description: Square brackets open outwards from the middle around two short bars, one wine, one ink.

items.name: Quote marks
items.description: Two wine opening quotation marks rise into place one after the other over a hairline.

items.name: Asterisk spin
items.description: A six-armed wine asterisk opens from its centre and keeps turning slowly: the footnote mark.

items.name: Check
items.description: An ink ring draws round, then a wine tick draws inside it.

items.name: Plus
items.description: A plus drawn from its centre: the ink stroke across, then the wine stroke down.

items.name: Seal ring
items.description: A seal: a wine ring draws, a circle of short ink ticks appears round it one by one and turns slowly, and a small asterisk opens in the middle.

items.name: Folio flip
items.description: A page turns over about its spine twice (paper, stone, then the wine cover with two lines) above a short folio rule.

items.name: Column grid
items.description: The columns of a page grid drop from a head rule one after another in umber and fog; one column is wine.

items.name: Bookmark
items.description: A wine ribbon bookmark with a swallow-tail slides down from the top edge of a stone page and settles.

items.name: Drop cap
items.description: A wine drop-cap block lands at the head of a paragraph whose lines draw beside and under it.
